metrics.firstDeathWave: wave of the first capture per run (solo: the only capture); unit run
metrics.teamDeathWave: wave when no player remains; unit run
metrics.enemiesPerLivingPlayer: mean over enemy turns of non-boss enemies / living players; unit run
metrics.finalRank: rank per player at end; unit player
metrics.aloneWaves: co-op enemy turns that end with exactly one living player (the other spectates); unit run
metrics.revives: co-op reward revives taken; the auto policy always takes the first option, so every offer is taken; unit run

policy: game autoMove for every player; first reward option; contracts declined
limit: Fixed auto policy; seeds are paired across variants but not human players. Survival waves are not play time or fun.
